item.title: Footpaths on North Bridge set for major upgrade
item.description: Hull City Council will soon begin essential maintenance work to upgrade the footpaths on North Bridge. Due to general wear and tear, the footpaths on the bridge – which connects George Street to Witham – have reached the end of their service life and need replacing.
